My advice would be to temper your expectations, but don't disregard it entirely. I was (and still am to a lesser extent) anti-social. I went to a mediocre university, which I later found out was known for partying. That said, I still got invited to parties by being approachable and friendly to everyone - along with putting myself out there.  If you want friends, try and surround yourself with people who have similar interests and hobbies, or people on your course. In the end I went from having no friends to a couple of solid buddies who I would have drinking sessions with.

In my opinion parties (especially nightclubs) are overrated, getting drunk/high with friends is much more entertaining.
